items.title: Jack DeJohnette interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, April 7, 2025
items.q: Yeah and what’s the name — Fats Domino.

ctx.x: And were you playing early rock & roll like Chuck Berry and Little Richard, that kind of thing?
Yeah and what’s the name — Fats Domino. And I also spent a little time in a cappella doo-wop groups too, singing with them.
I read that you had perfect pitch. I wonder if they depended on you for that?
